## Email Triage Assistant
Sorts the inbox into act now, reply today, read later and ignore, and drafts the replies.

Every new Gmail message is categorised (client, invoice, meeting, newsletter, phishing) and prioritised using VIP senders, urgency words and questions. 'Act now' emails ping you on Slack with a drafted reply; suspected phishing is flagged. Edit VIPS in the Logic node.

**Try it:** click *Test workflow* to run on the sample data. Then connect your credentials on the output nodes and activate.

Code and docs: github.com/Princewill106/email-triage-assistant
